description: Walk the prerequisite chain for a compliance node. Given one node, returns its full dependency tree (the prior obligations an agent must satisfy before this one applies). Use this to plan a complete compliance posture: unlocking one node usually requires understanding 3-8 upstream nodes. Defaults to depth 2; max 4.

max_depth.description: How many hops to walk (1-4). Default 2.

node_id.description: Root node ID to expand from.

name: get_dependency_chain
